svg.title: IMGT and North CDR definitions compared on identical antibody sequences
svg.desc: Four sequence panels compare IMGT and North membership for Herceptin heavy-chain CDR1, CDR2 and CDR3 and the MS6-12 kappa light-chain CDR2. All displayed position labels use IMGT numbering. Hatched columns represent unoccupied labels, not amino acids. IMGT versus North occupied lengths are 8 versus 13 for H1, 8 versus 10 for H2, 13 versus 13 for H3, and 3 versus 8 for L2. Gold marks conserved cysteines and tryptophans, while boxed labels mark the IMGT flanking anchors. This is an annotation diagram, not a depiction of three-dimensional structure.
svg.text: Every position label below is IMGT. Colored bands select occupied residues.
North adds the flanks at IMGT 24–26 and 39–40.
Hatching = an unoccupied IMGT label; it is not counted as a residue.
North includes both IMGT CDR2 anchors: Arg55 and Arg66.
Hatching = an unoccupied IMGT label; it is not counted as a residue.
Both select the same 13 residues, excluding Cys104 and Trp118.
No gaps in the displayed IMGT labels.
D. L2 · MS6-12 κ light domain
North L2 extends to AHo 72 (IMGT 69 in this light domain).
Hatching = an unoccupied IMGT label; it is not counted as a residue.
North bands use AHo ranges H1 24–42, H2 57–69, H3 107–138, L2 57–72.
Data: frozen crosswalk; PDB 1N8Z entity 2 / chain B and 1MJU entity 1 / chain L.
Definitions: Lefranc et al. (2003); North et al. (2011); Guest et al. (2021).
